name: Scientific Policy Resolution, 1958
change: Established the importance of scientific research and development as a national priority, focusing on building scientific institutions and human resources.
impact: Laid the foundation for India's scientific growth and institutional development, enabling long-term innovation capacity.

name: Establishment of IIT System, 1951
change: Creation of premier engineering institutions to develop highly skilled technical manpower.
impact: Produced a strong scientific workforce that contributed to global and domestic technological advancement.

name: Atomic Energy Programme, 1948
change: Development of nuclear energy capabilities for peaceful and strategic purposes under government control.
impact: Strengthened energy security and positioned India as a nuclear-capable nation.

name: ISRO Formation Policy, 1969
change: Establishment of a national space agency to develop satellite, launch vehicle, and space applications.
impact: Enabled India to become a global leader in cost-effective space technology and satellite services.

name: Department of Biotechnology Policy, 1986
change: Creation of a dedicated department to promote biotechnology research in agriculture, medicine, and industry.
impact: Boosted innovation in healthcare, agriculture, and industrial biotechnology.

name: Technology Policy Statement, 1983
change: Focused on technological self-reliance and development of indigenous capabilities.
impact: Encouraged domestic innovation and reduced dependence on foreign technology.

name: Information Technology Policy, 1998
change: Promoted software development, IT exports, and digital infrastructure growth.
impact: Transformed India into a global IT hub and boosted economic growth.

name: National Innovation Policy, 2013
change: Focused on fostering innovation through collaboration between academia, industry, and government.
impact: Strengthened startup ecosystem and research commercialization.

name: Digital India Programme, 2015
change: Promoted digital infrastructure, e-governance, and digital services across the country.
impact: Revolutionized access to services and enabled large-scale digital inclusion.

name: National AI Strategy, 2018
change: Focused on developing AI capabilities in sectors like healthcare, agriculture, and education.
impact: Positioned India as an emerging player in AI and advanced technologies.
